name: Supreme Broccoli Soup Casserole
description: A creamy broccoli casserole with a crunchy crouton topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Place cooked broccoli in a 9x9 inch pan.
Mix together mushroom soup, flour, sour cream, and seasonings. Pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle grated carrot, chopped onion, and croutons over the top.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 325°F for 1/2 hour.

keywords: broccoli casserole, creamy soup casserole, baked vegetable dish

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Cabbage Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy cabbage casserole with a crunchy bread crumb topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cabbage wedges until tender, then drain and cut into large pieces.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour, and milk. Season with salt, grated cheese, and Cheez Whiz.
Combine cooked cabbage with the white sauce mixture.
Top with crumbled buttered bread.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: cabbage casserole, creamy vegetable dish, comforting main course

_similar.name: Favourite Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and satisfying chicken dish baked with cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, and garlic.
recipeIngredient: 1 can cheddar cheese soup (or other soup to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and pat dry chicken breasts.
Combine cheddar cheese soup, mushroom soup, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Place chicken in a 9x11 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Top with grated cheese and sliced mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour for 4 pieces or 1½ hours for 6 pieces.
Check to ensure chicken is cooked through, as oven temperatures may vary.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.
